Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.Core.GroupLineAcces.description: The GroupLineAccess model represents a group line access object.

access.description: The indication whether the members of the user group may access the line.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.Core.Line.description: The Line model represents a line object.

line_id.description: The line ID, assigned by the system.

line_class.description: The indication whether the record is a line class. Line classes are not currently supported.

origin_line_class_id.description:
The ID of the line class from which this line was instantiated. This value is null for line classes and for lines that were not instantiated from a line
            class. Line classes are not currently supported.

labor_load.description: The number of people required to run the line that is reported to ERP.

max_wo.description: The maximum number of simultaneous work orders permitted on the line. The default is 1.

prod_ent_id.description: The entity that is the source of the production amount for the line.

std_item_id.description: The standard item to use for reporting the production rate.

batch_size.description: The standard batch size for reporting the production rate.

prod_uom.description:
<para>The production unit of measure:</para>
<para>0 = hours/batch (the default)</para>
<para>1 = minutes/batch</para>
<para>2 = seconds/batch</para>
<para>3 = batches/hour</para>
<para>4 = batches/minute</para>
<para>5 = batches/second</para>

bottleneck_ent_id.description:
The entity that is designated as the bottleneck on the line. Other entities in the same child order position as the bottleneck entity will also be
            considered to be bottleneck entities.

last_edit_at.description: The date and time when the record was added or last updated.

lineEntLinks.description: The list of the line-entity links for the line. The array structure is the same as that for the object that is returned by the endpoint.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.Core.LineEntity.description: The LineEntity model represents a line-entity link object.

ent_id.description: The entity ID or entity class.

child_order.description: The relative order number of the entity in the line.

input_pct.description: How much of the outflow from the set of child entities with the same parent and a child_order that is the next lower value to this one goes to the child entity.

line_is_child.description:
The indication whether the entity belongs to the line. If true, the entity belongs to the line. If false, the entity is the parent of the line (for
            example, the entity is a building or a site).

segment_no.description: The line segment number of the line of which the entity is a part. This value will be null (the default) if the entity is not part of a line segment. It will always be null if the LineIsChild property is true. It is not possible to save a line for which this value is not null for at least two adjacent ChildOrder values (in other words, no segments that are only one position long).

ent_enabled.description: The indication whether the entity is not to be bypassed by work orders. If true, the entity is not to be bypassed by work orders. If false, the entity will be bypassed by work orders. This property is not applicable if the LineIsChild property is true.

can_be_bottleneck.description: The indication that the entity is to be considered when determining the bottleneck entity for the line. If the entity cannot run jobs, then this property will be false. This property is not applicable if the link's LineIsChild property is true. For an entity class, the setting of this property serves as a default setting for entities selected from that class.

reorder.description: The reorder indication, which is always false. This property is currently not implemented.

last_edit_at.description: The date and time when the record was added or last updated.

my_entity.description: A JSON array with each entity in the line being a separate JSON record that contains the my_entity record. For example, if the call is messerver/api/V3/line/13/entity, the JSON array would be [{lineID:13, entID:1....my_entity{...}}, {lineID:13, ent ID2...my_entity{...}}].

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.EnProd.BulkInventor.description: The BulkInventoryMove model represents the object used to move quantities from multiple inventory locations to a single destination location. Note that the following property values for the item at the destination storage entity can be different than those for the item once the inventory is moved to the destination storage entity: item ID, lot number, sublot number, grade code, status code, and expiry date.

from_ent_id.description: Required. The ID of the storage entity source.

to_ent_id.description: The ID of the destination storage entity.

from_item_id.description: The ID of the item at the source storage entity.

to_item_id.description: The ID of the item when received at its destination storage entity.

from_lot_no.description: The item's lot number at the source storage entity.

to_lot_no.description: The item's lot number when received at its destination storage entity.

from_sublot_no.description: The item's sublot number at the source storage location.

to_sublot_no.description: The item's sublot number when received at its destination storage entity.

transfer_option.description: The enumeration of the transfer option, which determines how the item grade, status code, and expiry date are set for the moved and matching destination inventory if their values in the source and destination inventory don't match. For more information, see the ItemInventory BulkInventoryMove endpoint. 1 = An error is generated and inventory is not moved. 2 (the default) = Values that are supplied for to_grade_cd, to_status_cd, and to_expiry_date_utc in the request body are assigned to both the inventory being moved and to any inventory in a matching lot at the destination entity. For example, if to_grade_cd is 3 in the request body, then the moved inventory and any inventory with the same lot number at the destination entity is assigned item grade 3. If a value is not specified for any of these properties, then the value for that property in the matching destination lot is assigned to the moved inventory. 3 = The property values for the source inventory is assigned to the moved inventory and to any inventory with the same lot number at the destination entity. Values that are supplied for to_grade_cd, to_status_cd, and to_expiry_date_utc in the request body are ignored. For example, if the item status code for the source inventory is 2, then the moved inventory and any inventory with the same lot number at the destination entity is assigned the item status of 2.

log_inventory_transfer.description: Indicates whether this inventory transfer is to be logged as an item transfer.

to_grade_cd.description: The item's grade code when received at the destination storage entity.

to_status_cd.description: The item's status code when received at the destination storage entity.

to_uom_id.description: The item's grade code when received at the destination storage entity.

to_expiry_date_utc.description: The item's expiry date when received at the destination storage entity, in UTC.

to_wo_id.description: The work order ID of the the job that transfers the inventory.

to_oper_id.description: The operation ID of the the job that transfers the inventory.

to_seq_no.description: The sequence number of the the job that transfers the inventory.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.EnProd.ItemInventor.description: The ItemInventory model represents an item inventory object.

ent_id.description: The ID of the item's storage entity.

qty_left.description: The current item quantity at the entity.

qty_left_erp.description: The current item quantity at the entity as last transmitted to an ERP system.

date_in_utc.description: The date and time that this item inventory was last received at the storage entity, in UTC.

date_out_utc.description: The date and time that this item inventory was last sent from the storage entity, in UTC.

expiry_date_utc.description: The item's expiry date and time, in UTC.

wo_id.description: The work order ID of the job that last produced items in this inventory.

oper_id.description: The operation ID of the job that last produced items in this inventory.

seq_no.description: The sequence number of the job that last produced items in this inventory.

from_ent_id.description: The ID of the entity from which the item inventory was transferred to this storage entity.

must_consume_from_inv.description: The indication whether consumption of this item must occur from the item's inventory.

must_consume_from_wip.description: The indication whether consumption of this item must occur from work in progress (that is, from items produced at an upstream job in the work order).

uom_id.description: The ID of the item's unit of measure . If null, the UOM is the native units of the item.

spare1.description: The contents of the spare1 field.

spare2.description: The contents of the spare2 field.

spare3.description: The contents of the spare3 field.

spare4.description: The contents of the spare4 field.

spare5.description: The contents of the spare5 field.

spare6.description: The contents of the spare6 field.

goods_received_shipped.description: The indication whether this inventory transaction involves receiving or shipping goods when adding or reducing the item inventory.

check_grade_status.description: Indicates whether item grade and status for the inventory transaction must be validated by another user.

transfer_comments.description: The comments for the inventory transfer.

log_inventory_transfer.description: The indication whether the inventory transfer is logged in the Item_Transfer table.

row_id.description: The unique row ID of the item inventory record in the Item_Inv table. For a Put, the row ID is used as an input parameter to identify the record to update. For a Post or Put, the row ID is returned to identify the record that was added or updated.

last_edit_at.description: The date and time when the item inventory record was added or last edited, in UTC.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.EnProd.ItemInventor.description: The ItemInventorySource model represents an inventory location from which a specified quantity of inventory is moved. The inventory_from_row_id property is required. All other properties are optional.

inventory_from_row_id.description: The unique row ID of the source item inventory record in the Item_Inv table. For a Put, the row ID is used as an input parameter to identify the record to update. For a Post or Put, the row ID is returned to identify the record that was added or updated.

storage_ent_id.description: The ID of the source storage entity.

last_edit_at.description: The date and time when the source item inventory record was added or last edited, in UTC.

transfer_qty_erp.description: The transfer quantity to be reported to an ERP system.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.EnProd.ItemTransfer.description: The ItemTransfer model represents an item transfer object.

wo_id.description: The work order ID of the job for which the transfer occurs.

oper_id.description: The operation ID of the job for which the transfer occurs.

seq_no.description: The sequence number of the job for which the transfer occurs.

bom_pos.description: The BOM position for which the transfer occurs.

to_ent_id.description: The ID of the destination storage entity.

item_id.description: The ID of the transferred item.

lot_no.description: The lot number of the transferred item.

sub_lot_no.description: The sublot number of the transferred item.

uom_id.description: The ID of the unit of measure for the transferred item quantity.

to_spare1.description: The contents of the transfer to_spare1 field.

to_spare2.description: The contents of the transfer to_spare2 field.

to_spare3.description: The contents of the transfer to_spare3 field.

to_spare4.description: The contents of the transfer to_spare4 field.

to_spare5.description: The contents of the transfer to_spare5 field.

to_spare6.description: The contents of the transfer to_spare6 field.

from_wo_id.description: The work order ID of the original job that produced the inventory, if that job is different than the job that transfers the inventory.

from_oper_id.description: The operation ID of the original job that produced the inventory, if that job is different than the job that transfers the inventory.

from_seq_no.description: The sequence number of the original job that produced the inventory, if that job is different than the job that transfers the inventory.

from_ent_id.description: The ID of the entity that is the source for the inventory transfer.

from_item_id.description: The ID of the item at the source entity if the item ID is changed by the transfer.

from_lot_no.description:
The lot number of the item at the source entity if the lot number is changed by the transfer. 
Null indicates that the lot number didn't change.

from_sub_lot_no.description:
The sublot number of the item at the source entity if the sublot number is changed by the transfer.
Null indicates that the sublot number didn't change.

from_grade_cd.description:
The grade code of the item at the source entity if the item grade is changed by the transfer. 
Null indicates that the item grade didn't change.

from_status_cd.description:
The status code of the item at the source entity if the item status is changed by the transfer. 
Null indicates that the item status didn't change.

from_qty_txd.description:
The item quantity at the source entity that is transferred if the quantity UOM is changed by the transfer. 
Null indicates that the quantity didn't change.

from_uom_id.description:
The ID of the unit of measure for the item quantity at the source entity if the UOM is changed by the transfer. 
Null indicates that the UOM didn't change.

from_expiry_date.description:
The expiry date for the item at the source entity if the expiry date is changed by the transfer. 
Null indicates that the expiry date didn't change.

from_spare1.description: The contents of the transfer from_spare1 field.

from_spare2.description: The contents of the transfer from_spare2 field.

from_spare3.description: The contents of the transfer from_spare3 field.

from_spare4.description: The contents of the transfer from_spare4 field.

from_spare5.description: The contents of the transfer from_spare5 field.

from_spare6.description: The contents of the transfer from_spare6 field.

qty_txd_erp.description: The item quantity transferred as last transmitted to an ERP system.

goods_received.description: Indicates whether the inventory is goods received from a supplier.

goods_shipped.description: Indicates whether the inventory is goods shipped to a customer.

transfer_list_row_id.description:
The row ID of the transfer list record in the Transfer_List table for which this row is a partial or complete fulfillment. 
This property is not currently used.

comments.description: The comments about the item transfer.

mod_id.description:
The current modification ID of the item transfer record in the Item_Transfer table. 
This ID is binary number that increments each time the record's table row is modified. 
Optionally used for optimistic concurrency control when performing updates or deletes.

transfer_id.description: The row ID of the inventory transfer record in the Item_Transfer table. For a Put, the row ID is used as an input parameter to identify the record to update. For a Post or Put, the row ID is returned to identify the record that was added or updated.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.EnProd.MoveInventor.description: The MoveInventory model represents the object used to move quantities from multiple inventory locations to a single destination location. Note that the following property values for the item at the destination storage entity can be different than those for the item once the inventory is moved to the destination storage entity: item ID, lot number, sublot number, grade code, status code, and expiry date.

list_of_inv_locs_to_move_from.description:
An array of objects that represent the inventory locations from which the inventory is transferred and the quantity moved from each location.
            The object body is of type <see cref="T:Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.EnProd.ItemInventorySource">ItemInventorySource</see>.

to_ent_id.description: The ID of the destination storage entity.

to_item_id.description: The ID of the item when received at its destination storage entity.

to_lot_no.description: The item's lot number when received at its destination storage entity.

to_sublot_no.description: The item's sublot number when received at its destination storage entity.

to_grade_cd.description: The item's grade code when received at its destination storage entity.

to_status_cd.description: The item's status code when received at its destination storage entity.

to_uom_id.description: The item's grade code when received at its destination storage entity.

to_expiry_date_utc.description: The item's expiry date when received at its destination storage entity, in UTC.

to_wo_id.description: The work order ID of the the job that transfers the inventory.

to_oper_id.description: The operation ID of the the job that transfers the inventory.

to_seq_no.description: The sequence number of the the job that transfers the inventory.

transfer_option.description: The enumeration of the transfer option, which determines how the item grade, status code, and expiry date are set for the moved and matching destination inventory if their values in the source and destination inventory don't match. For more information, see the ItemInventoryController model. 1 = An error is generated and inventory is not moved. 2 = Values that are supplied for to_grade_cd, to_status_cd, and to_expiry_date_utc in the request body are assigned to both the inventory being moved and to any inventory in a matching lot at the destination entity. For example, if to_grade_cd is 3 in the request body, then the moved inventory and any inventory with the same lot number at the destination entity is assigned item grade 3. If a value is not specified for any of these properties, then the value for that property in the matching destination lot is assigned to the moved inventory. 3 = The property values for the source inventory is assigned to the moved inventory and to any inventory with the same lot number at the destination entity. Values that are supplied for to_grade_cd, to_status_cd, and to_expiry_date_utc in the request body are ignored. For example, if the item status code for the source inventory is 2, then the moved inventory and any inventory with the same lot number at the destination entity is assigned the item status of 2.

move_inventory_to_downstream_job.description:
<para>Indicates whether the inventory is moved to a downstream job.</para>
<para>This flag is used for serialized items. If the destination item is configured to identify the inventory quantities uniquely by job (item.inv_unique_by_job = true), 
            this flag is set to true, and the override serialization flag for this work order is set to false, 
            then the inventory table identifying which job produced this serial number will be updated 
            to match those of any job immediately preceding the first job identified by the work order and operation that produces the item being transferred. 
            If there are no such upstream jobs, then these fields are left unchanged.</para>

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.EnProd.ScrapInvento.description: The ScrapInventory model represents the object that is used to scrap quantities from an item inventory. This model is used with the Item Inventory Scrap Delete operation.

from_ent_id.description: The ID of the entity at which the inventory to be scrapped is stored.

item_id.description: The item ID. When using the item inventory Scrap endpoint, this property can be set to null to scrap all inventory.

qty_cons.description: The amount of quantity to be scrapped. Can be null (e.g., if item_id is null to scrap all inventory).The default is 0.

reas_cd.description: The item reason code for scrapping the inventory.

grade_cd.description: The item's grade code. Can be null if item_id is null to scrap all inventory.

status_cd.description: The item's status code. Can be null if item_id is null to scrap all inventory.

user_id.description: The ID of the user who ran the job that scraps the item.

wo_id.description: The work order ID of the job that produces the inventory.

oper_id.description: The operation ID of the job that produces the inventory.

seq_no.description: The sequence number of the job that produces the inventory.

shift_start_utc.description:
The shift start time, in UTC, that is used to identify the item consumption record.
The scrapped quantity is also recorded as item consumption.

fg_lot_no.description:
The finished goods lot number that is used to identify the item consumption record.
The scrapped quantity is also recorded as item consumption.

fg_sublot_no.description:
The finished goods sublot number that is used to identify the item consumption record.
The scrapped quantity is also recorded as item consumption.

item_scrapped.description: Indicates whether the item is scrapped. This will always be true.

ent_id.description: The ID of the entity on which the job that produces the scrapped inventory is run.

shift_id.description:
The ID of the shift that is used to identify the item consumption record.
The scrapped quantity is also recorded as item consumption.

qty_cons_erp.description: The consumption quantity as transmitted to an ERP system.

ext_ref.description: The item's external reference (e.g., to an external system for defect tracking or any other purpose).

transaction_type.description:
<para>The transaction type enumerated value.</para>
<para>0 = normal</para>
<para>1 = lot split</para>
<para>2 = lot combination</para>

comments.description: The comments about the scrapping of the inventory.

spare1.description: The contents of the spare1 field.

spare2.description: The contents of the spare2 field.

spare3.description: The contents of the spare3 field.

spare4.description: The contents of the spare4 field.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.EnProd.ScrapInvento.description: The ScrapInventory2 model represents the object that is used to scrap quantities from an item inventory. This model is used with the Item Inventory ScrapWithStorageExec Put operation.

ent_id.description: The ID of the entity at which the inventory to be scrapped is stored.

item_id.description: The item ID. When using the item inventory Scrap endpoint, this property can be set to null to scrap all inventory.

qty_to_scrap.description: The amount of quantity to be scrapped. Can be null (e.g., if item_id is null to scrap all inventory).The default is 0.

qty_to_scrap_erp.description: The consumption quantity as transmitted to an ERP system.

scrap_uom_id.description: The ID of the unit of measure for the quantity to scrap.

grade_cd.description: The item's grade code. Can be null if item_id is null to scrap all inventory.

status_cd.description: The item's status code. Can be null if item_id is null to scrap all inventory.

date_out_utc.description: The date when the quantity was scrapped, in UTC.

wo_id.description: The work order ID of the job that produces the inventory.

oper_id.description: The operation ID of the job that produces the inventory.

seq_no.description: The sequence number of the job that produces the inventory.

transfer_comments.description: The transfer comments for the scrap.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.Entity.description: The Entity model represents an entity object.

ent_id.description: The entity ID, assigned by the system.

parent_ent_id.description:
The parent ID from which this entity will inherit entity associations that can only be inherited from one parent entity, such as a shift schedule. For a
            top-level entity, the value will be null.

preferred_parent.description: The indication whether the parent entity that the parent_ent_id property value identified is the preferred parent. For entities with multiple parents, the default parent entity—or preferred parent—determines at which parent entity the system will look when determining the entity's inherited associations. If the preferred parent has the entity associations that can only be inherited from one parent entity, such as a shift schedule, this property will be true. If the preferred parent does not have any of the entity associations that can only be inherited from one parent entity, such as a shift schedule, the system looks up through the preferred parent's ancestors for a parent that does. That parent will be the one identified by the parent_ent_id property value and this property will be false.

can_sched_jobs.description: The indication whether the jobs can be scheduled to this entity.

can_run_jobs.description: The indication whether jobs can be run on this entity. For an entity on a line, this value will always be true.

can_capture_util.description: The indication whether utilization data can be captured on this entity. For an entity on a line, this value will always be true.

can_capture_labor.description: The indication whether labor data can be captured on this entity.

can_track_oee.description: The indication whether the OEE statistics can be captured on this entity. For an entity on a line, this value will always be true.

can_sched_shifts.description: The indication whether shifts can be scheduled for this entity.

can_store.description: The indication whether this entity can be a "warehouse" or storage location.

can_log_data.description: The indication whether this entity can log data.

can_ship.description: The indication whether shipments can be made from this entity.

can_receive.description: The indication whether a material can be received at this entity.

can_copy_folders.description: The indication whether the files in the folders for this entity can be copied to its download directories.

can_capture_qm_data.description: The indication whether QM data can be captured on this entity and have sample requests generated for it.

identical_job_execs.description:
The maximum number of jobs that can be run at the same time on this entity. For an entity on a line, this value will be either 0 or 1. If 0 is returned,
            it has the same meaning as 1; that is, only one job can be run at a time on the entity.

last_edit_at.description: The date and time when the record was added or last updated.

exact_match.description:
<para>The indication whether the entity can run jobs, can capture utilization, can track OEE, have only one job position, are not linked to any line (as parents
            or children), have a non-null default production rate, and matches the filter criteria. Entities for which this property is true are eligible to be added to a
            line.</para>
<para>This property is used by the Entity GetByFilter endpoint (/api/V3/Entity/key) to indicate that an entity matches the filter supplied  so as to distinguish it
            from an entity that is being returned as part of the hierarchy above that entity.</para>

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.MesTransaction.description: The MesTransaction model represents a transaction object.

trans_start_utc.description: The date and time in UTC when the transaction was started.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.OeeExec.description: The OeeExec model represents the OEE executor object.

prod_uom.description:
<para>The production unit of measure:</para>
<para>0 = hours/batch</para>
<para>1 = minutes/batch</para>
<para>2 = seconds/batch</para>
<para>3 = batches/hour</para>
<para>4 = batches/minute</para>
<para>5 = batches/second</para>

batch_size.description: The standard batch size for reporting production rate.

std_item_id.description: The standard item ID to use for reporting production rate.

last_edit_at.description: The date and time when the record was added or last updated.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.Prod.ChangeJobState.description: The ChangeJobStates model includes the parameters for changing the job state, required finish time, and scheduling priority for one or more jobs.

state_cd.description:
<para>An enumeration value that indicates the new job state.</para>
<para>1 = New</para>
<para>2 = Ready</para>
<para>3 = Running</para>
<para>4 = Completed</para>
<para>5 = Suspended</para>
<para>6 = On Hold</para>
<para>7 = Canceled</para>

req_finish_time_utc.description: The required finish time of the job in UTC.

job_priority.description: The scheduling priority of the job on the entity.

apply_to_all_jobs.description:
A flag that indicates whether to apply changes to all jobs in the same work orders as the jobs identified 
            by the row_id array. For example, if this flag is true and row_id specifies one job, all jobs that are 
            in that job's work order are changed as well.

row_id.description: The row IDs for the jobs to be changed.

warning_message.description: The returned message from the stored procedure.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.Prod.ChangeWOQuanti.description: The ChangeWOQuantities model represents the parameters for the ChangeWOQuantities call.

wo_id.description: The identifier of the work order.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.Prod.Item.description: The Item model represents an item object.

item_class_id.description: The ID of the item class to which the item is assigned.

uom_id.description: The ID of the unit of measure for the item.

template.description: A flag that indicates whether the item is a template to be copied (true) or an actual item (false).

lifetime.description: The life time in days of the item before it expires. If null, the item never expires.

unit_cost.description: The per unit cost to purchase the item.

obsolete.description: A flag that indicates whether the item is obsolete.

purchased.description: A flag that indicates whether the item can be purchased.

sold.description: A flag that indicates whether the item can be sold.

num_decimals.description: The number of decimal places to use for quantities of the item.

must_complete_steps.description:
A flag that indicates whether all steps must be completed/bypassed to end a job, regardless of the Job_Exec setting, 
when producing this item.

must_prod_reqd_qty.description:
A flag that indicates whether the quantity produced must be at least equal to the quantity required to end the job, 
regardless of Job_Exec setting, when producing this item.

min_grade.description: The lowest grade of the item to consider it shippable.

min_state.description: The lowest state of the item to consider it shippable.

min_inv_level.description: The minimum overall amount of this item to be kept in inventory. When this amount is reached, a replenishment order should be generated.

reorder_amt.description: The minimum amount of the item in an inventory replenishment order.

auto_reorder.description: A flag that indicates whether item inventory replenishment orders should be generated automatically.

lot_no_format.description: The default lot number format for the item.

last_lot_no.description: The last lot number assigned to any of the units for the item.

max_lot_size.description: The maximum size of a lot for the item, in its UOM units.

sublot_no_format.description: The default sublot number format for the item.

last_sublot_no.description: The last sublot number assigned to any of the units for the item.

serial_no_lvl.description:
<para>An enumeration that indicates how the item's serial number is determined.</para>
<para>0 = the lot number is the serial number</para>
<para>1 or greater = the sublot level that is the serial number</para>
<para>-1 = serial numbers are not used (the default)</para>

max_sublot_size.description: The maximum size of a sublot for the item, in its UOM units.

max_order_size.description: The maximum starting quantity for a work order for the item.

min_trace_inv.description:
The minimum amount of inventory of a particular lot that will be maintained in a storage entity 
for which the indistinguishable_lots flag is true. Lesser amounts will be merged into another lot 
of the same item in the same location.

inv_unique_by_job.description: A flag that indicates whether inventory for this item should be uniquely identified by the job that is producing it.

spare1.description: The contents of the user-defined spare1 field.

spare2.description: The contents of the user-defined spare2 field.

spare3.description: The contents of the user-defined spare3 field.

spare4.description: The contents of the user-defined spare4 field.

last_edit_at.description: When the record was added or last updated.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.Prod.Job.description: The Job model represents a job object.

wo_id.description: The work order ID for the job.

oper_id.description: The operation ID for the job.

seq_no.description: The sequence number for the job.

qty_reqd.description: The quantity of good production that the job must produce.

qty_prod.description: The item quantity that has been produced by the job.

job_pos.description: The job position used to run the job. If the job is not running, the value is null.

deviation_above.description: The portion of the start quantity by which total production can deviate above.

deviation_below.description: The portion of the start quantity by which total production can deviate below.

batch_size.description: The amount of production per batch.

sched_pinned.description: The indication whether the job start time is fixed and cannot be changed.

est_fixed_lab.description: The estimated amount of fixed labor time, in hours, that is needed for job-related setup and cleanup work.

est_lab_rate.description: The estimated amount of variable labor time per batch, in hours, that is needed to run the job.

est_setup_time.description: The estimated amount of time, in hours, that is needed for job-related setup work.

est_teardown_time.description: The estimated amount of time, in hours, that is needed for job-related teardown work.

est_prod_rate.description: The estimated amount of time per batch, in hours, that is needed to run the job.

cur_rate_finish_time_utc.description: The date and time, in UTC, when the work order will be completed based on the current production rate.

std_rate_finish_time_utc.description: The date and time, in UTC, when the work order will be completed based on the standard production rate.

target_finish_time_utc.description: The date and time, in UTC, when the work order will be completed based on the target production rate.

sched_finish_time_utc.description: The scheduled finish time of the job, in UTC.

act_start_time_utc.description: The actual finish time of the job, in UTC.

act_finish_time_utc.description: The actual finish time of the job, in UTC.

item_id.description:
The ID of the item that results from the job. This item can be different than the item being produced by the work order if the job is not the final job in the
            work order (e.g., a component part).

state_desc.description:
<para>The description of the current job state:</para>
<para>New</para>
<para>Ready</para>
<para>Running</para>
<para>Complete</para>
<para>Suspended</para>
<para>Onhold</para>
<para>Canceled</para>

color.description: The name or hex value of the HTML color for the color of the job state in the user interface.

prod_uom.description:
<para>The production unit of measure:</para>
<para>0 = hours/batch</para>
<para>1 = minutes/batch</para>
<para>2 = seconds/batch</para>
<para>3 = batches/hour</para>
<para>4 = batches/minute</para>
<para>5 = batches/second</para>

est_transfer_time.description: The estimated amount of transfer time, in hours, that is needed after the operation.

sched_start_time_utc.description: The scheduled start time of the job, in UTC.

latest_start_time_utc.description: The latest time by which the job should start, in UTC, to meet the required finish time.

concurrent_link.description:
The number used to link the job to other concurrent jobs so that all linked jobs start at the same time. A value of 0 indicates that there are no
            other concurrent jobs.

job_cost.description: The additional (i.e., non-labor, non-machine, and non-material) cost associated specifically with this job.

parent_contingent_job.description: The indication whether this job is for a group that will really be run by one or more child jobs.

child_contingent_job.description: The indication whether this job is a potential job for one of a group of entities.

qty_at_start.description: The item quantity that the job will produce if nothing is scrapped.

qty_prod_erp.description: The quantity produced value that was transferred to an ERP system.

qty_rejected.description: The item quantity that has been rejected as part of the job.

qty_rejected_erp.description: The quantity rejected value that was transferred to an ERP system.

job_priority.description: The scheduling priority of the job on the entity.

notes.description:
<para>The specific notes for this job, typically for the operator to read.</para>
<para>Notes will only be recorded when jobs are changed to the New, Suspend, or OnHold states.</para>

req_finish_time_utc.description: The required finish time of the job, in UTC.

state_cd.description:
<para>An enumeration value that indicates the job state.</para>
<para>1 = New</para>
<para>2 = Ready</para>
<para>3 = Running</para>
<para>4 = Completed</para>
<para>5 = Suspended</para>
<para>6 = On Hold</para>
<para>7 = Canceled</para>

run_ent_id.description: The ID of the entity on which the job is actually run.

run_ent_name.description: The name of the entity on which the job is actually run.

qty_remaining.description: The item quantity defined as the difference between the start quantity and the sum of the quantity produced and the quantity rejected (qty_at_start - (qty_prod + qty_rejected)).

init_sched_ent_id.description: The ID of the entity on which the job is or was initially scheduled.

init_sched_ent_name.description: The name of the entity on which the job is or was initially scheduled.

target_sched_ent_id.description: The ID of the entity on which the job is actually scheduled.

target_sched_ent_name.description: The name of the entity on which the job is actually scheduled.

uom_description.description: The description of the production unit of measure.

row_id.description: The row ID of the job record.

num_decimals.description: The number of decimals to be used when displaying quantities for the item produced by the job.

num_decimals_good_pp.description: The value of the system attribute Max decimals of good piece part entries (attr_id 326 in the System_Attr table) to determine the maximum number of decimals to use when num_decimals is 0.

assoc_file.description: The path and file name of the file associated with the job.

assoc_file_type.description: The file type of the file associated with the job.

status_notes.description: Notes about the current job status.

display_seq.description: The sequence number for this job. The number determines the order of jobs when displayed in job trees and flow diagrams in the user interface.

folder_ver_id.description: The version of the folder that contains associated files assigned to the job.

rework.description: The indication whether the job has required or does require rework.

rework_cd.description: The number code that identifies the type of rework that is or was required.

rework_process_id.description: For rework jobs that were added to an existing work order, the ID of the process from which the rework job was instantiated.

last_edit_comment.description: The comments about why the record was added or updated.

edit_time.description: The last time the job record was edited. Optionally used for optimistic concurrency control when performing updates or deletes.

check_privs.description: A flag that indicates whether user privileges should be checked in the back end.

check_certs.description: A flag that indicates whether certifications should be checked.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.Prod.JobAttr.description: The JobAttr model represents a job attribute object.

wo_id.description: The work order ID for the job.

oper_id.description: The operation ID for the job.

mod_id.description:
The current modification ID of the attribute record in the Job_Attr table. 
This ID is a binary number that increments each time the record's table row is modified. 
Optionally used for optimistic concurrency control when performing updates or deletes.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.Prod.JobExec.description: The JobExec model represents a job executor object.

next_job_only.description:
The indication whether the next job in the queue must be started or any job in the queue can be started when the current job is completed. If it is set to
            False, then any job in the queue can be started when the current job is completed. If it is set to True, then the next job in the queue must be started when
            the current job is completed. If the user has the permission to override the queue, that condition takes precedence over this flag.

item_based_desc.description: The indication whether the description is item-based.

def_to_ent_id.description: The default storage entity ID for the production item.

def_reject_ent_id.description: The default storage entity ID that is to receive reject production.

def_from_ent_id.description: The default storage entity ID for item issues.

def_prod_reas_cd.description: The default reason code for good production.

def_cons_reas_cd.description: The default reason code for normal consumption.

autoload_job_specs.description: The indication whether the entity should automatically load job specifications to tags.

auto_seq_start_option.description:
<para>Specifies when to automatically start the job with the next sequence number:</para>
<para>0 = Do not start the job with the next sequence number automatically</para>
<para>1 = Start the job with the next sequence number when the job with the previous sequence number is completed</para>

auto_job_start_option.description:
<para>Specifies when to automatically start the job:</para>
<para>0 = Do not start the job automatically</para>
<para>1 = Start the next scheduled job when ready and the previous job has completed.</para>
<para>2 = Start the next scheduled job with the work order specified in the tag that just changed.</para>

auto_job_end_option.description:
<para>The option that specifies when to automatically end the job:</para>
<para>0 = Do not end the job automatically</para>
<para>1 = End the job when the quantity produced is equal to or greater than the required quantity</para>

incl_class_reas.description: The indication whether to include item class reasons with the entity reason.

must_complete_steps.description: The indication whether all steps must be completed or bypassed to end the job.

must_prod_reqd_qty.description: The indication whether the required quantity of good production must be met to end the job.

local_movable_cons_ent.description: The indication whether movable storage entities that are supplying consumption need to be located at or in the entity doing the consumption. Not currently used.

local_movable_prod_ent.description: The indication whether movable storage entities that are receiving production need to be located at or in the entity doing the production. Not currently used.

run_without_operator.description: The indication whether jobs can run without an operator logged onto this entity.

suppress_start_qty_prompt.description:
The indication whether to suppress the prompt to specify a quantity to start that is typically displayed when the Start Some button is
            selected.

allow_zero_qty_split.description: The indication whether to set the default starting and required quantities to 0 when the Start Some button is selected.

auto_alloc_qty_to_running_job.description:
The indication whether to tell the system to automatically split sufficient quantities from a scheduled, non-running job to the running job to cover production
            reported that is greater than allowed.

last_edit_at.description: The date and time when the record was added or last updated.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.Prod.Lot.description: The Lot model represents a lot object.

grade_cd.description: The item grade code of the lot.

status_cd.description: The item status code of the lot.

is_serial_no.description: Indicates whether the lot number is the serial number for items in the lot.

spare1.description: The contents of the spare1 field.

spare2.description: The contents of the spare2 field.

spare3.description: The contents of the spare3 field.

spare4.description: The contents of the spare4 field.

spare5.description: The contents of the spare5 field.

spare6.description: The contents of the spare6 field.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.Prod.OperEntLink.description: The OperEntLink model represents an operation-entity link object.

process_id.description: The ID of the process to which the operation belongs.

est_fixed_lab.description: The estimated amount of fixed labor time, in hours, that is needed for job-related setup and cleanup work.

est_lab_rate.description: The estimated amount of variable labor time per batch, in hours, that is needed to run the job.

est_setup_time.description: The estimated amount of time, in hours, that is needed for job-related setup work.

est_teardown_time.description: The estimated amount of time, in hours, that is needed for job-related teardown work.

est_prod_rate.description: The estimated amount of time per batch, in hours, that is needed to run the job.

prod_uom.description:
<para>The enumeration that indicates the production unit of measure:</para>
<para>0 = hours/batch</para>
<para>1 = minutes/batch</para>
<para>2 = seconds/batch</para>
<para>3 = batches/hour</para>
<para>4 = batches/minute</para>
<para>5 = batches/second</para>

batch_size.description: The amount of production per batch.

est_transfer_time.description: The estimated amount of transfer time, in hours, that is needed after the operation.

init_prod_pct.description:
The initial production percent required at 
this entity (if the first operation is done at multiple entities), or null for other cases.

parent_contingent_ent.description: Indicates whether the link is for a group. If true, the operation actually be run on one or more children entities. The default is false.

child_contingent_ent.description: Indicates whether the link is potentially for one of a group of entities. The default is false.

mod_id.description:
The current modification ID of the attribute record in the Oper_Ent_Link table. 
This ID is binary number that increments each time the record's table row is modified.
Optionally used for optimistic concurrency control when performing updates or deletes.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.Prod.Production.description: The Production model represents an item production object.

row_id.description: The row ID of the item production record in the Item_Prod table.

user_id.description: The ID of the user who is making this production entry. For a Post, if the user ID is not provided here, the caller's user ID will be used.

site_name.description: The name of the site to which the entity belongs.

reas_cd.description: The reason code that uniquely identifies grade + status of goods produced.

to_ent_name.description: The name of the storage entity for produced goods.

to_site_name.description: The name of the site of the storage entity for produced goods.

byproduct_bom_pos.description: The BOM position if the production is for the byproducts.

ext_ref.description: The item's external reference (e.g., to an external system for defect tracking or any other purpose).

apply_scaling_factor.description: Indicates whether to apply a scaling factor. The scaling factor is used to get the correct units from counts if counts are item-dependent.

spare1.description: The contents of the user-defined spare1 field.

spare2.description: The contents of the user-defined spare2 field.

spare3.description: The contents of the user-defined spare3 field.

spare4.description: The contents of the user-defined spare4 field.

created_at_utc.description: The date and time when the item production is recorded, in UTC.

prod_info.description: Additional information about the production transaction after the call is processed against the middleware.

job_pos.description: The job position. The default is 0.

check_privs.description: Indicates whether user privileges are to be checked before adding production.

processed.description: A flag that indicates whether the production count has been processed.

move_status.description: A flag that indicates the move status.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.Prod.SetLotData.description: The SetLotData model represents the set of updated default values for a job BOM record.

wo_id.description: The work order ID for the job.

oper_id.description: The operation ID for the job.

seq_no.description: The sequence number for the job.

bom_pos.description:
<para>The BOM position.</para>
<para>0 for the current main production item (the default).</para>
<para>Positive values for consumption items. </para>
<para>Negative values for by-products.</para>

ent_id.description: The ID of the entity at which the job was performed.

job_pos.description: The job position if the entity is capable of running more than one job at a time.

def_item_id.description: The ID of the default component item being produced or consumed. Note that this property is ignored by a SetLotData Post and can't be used to change the item being produced or consumed by the job.

def_lot_no.description: The default lot of the item.

def_sublot_no.description: The default sublot of the item.

def_reas_cd.description:
The default consumption or production reason code. 
            If null, it defaults to the value specified for the entity that runs the job.

def_storage_ent_id.description:
The default storage entity for a product or by-product. 
            If null, it defaults to the default storage entity for the entity that runs the job.

update_inv.description: A flag that indicates whether inventory is updated with the consumed items.

backflush.description: A flag that indicates whether consumption is backflushed.

last_edit_at.description: When the record was added or last updated.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.Prod.SplitJob.description: The SplitJob model represents a job object that is to be split and may be started.

site_name.description: The site name, if sites are being used, at which the entity is located. Set to null if sites are not being used.

wo_id.description: The work order ID for the job to be split.

oper_id.description: The operation ID for the job to be split.

seq_no.description: The sequence number for the job to be split.

qty_at_start.description: The quantity of item that is expected to be produced if there are no scrap, waste, or rejects for the new job being created by the split.

req_qty.description: The required quantity of good production for the new job being created by the split.

status_notes.description: The status notes for the new job being created by the split.

state_cd.description: The state code for the new job being created by the split. If state_cd is set to Running (3), then the job will be started.

req_finish_time_utc.description: The required finish time, in UTC, for the new job being created by the split. If state_cd is set to Running (3), this value is ignored.

check_privs.description: The indication whether privileges are checked when starting the new job being created by the split. If state_cd is not set to Running (3), this value is ignored.

check_certs.description: The indication whether certifications are checked when starting the new job being created by the split. If state_cd is not set to Running (3), this value is ignored.

job_pos.description: The job position on which to start the new job being created by the split. If state_cd is not set to Running (3), this value is ignored. If set to null, the job will be started on the first job position

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.Prod.WO.description: The WO model represents a work order object.

process_id.description: The ID of the process from which the work order was created, if the work order was created from a process.

bom_ver_id.description: The BOM version of the original item that this work order produces specified when it was created, unless created on-the-fly.

spec_ver_id.description: The specification version selected for all operations (if any) when the work order was created, unless created on-the-fly.

item_id.description: The ID of the of the item being produced for the work order, unless all its jobs are disassembly jobs, in which case this is the initial item.

qty_at_start.description:
The quantity of items that the work order is expected to produce if there is no rejected production (that is, if all production is good). 
If the work order is assigned to a line, this quantity is based on the jobs performed at the entities identified as the production source for the line.

req_qty.description: The required quantity of items to be produced for the work order.

release_time_utc.description: When the work order was or will be released, in UTC.

req_finish_time_utc.description: When the work order must be completed, in UTC.

target_sched_line_id.description:
The ID of the production line to which the work order is assigned. 
            This will be null if the work order is not assigned to a line.

state_cd.description:
<para>The code that indicates the state of the work order.</para>
<para>0 = Released (default)</para>
<para>1 = Started</para>
<para>2 = Completed</para>
<para>3 = Closed. When closed, the work order can no longer be changed.</para>

wo_priority.description: The work order priority. This is used as the default priority for jobs in the work order.

cust_info.description: The customer information for the work order.

mo_id.description: The manufacturing order ID, for grouping different final parts.

production_schedule_id.description: The production schedule to which the work order (Production Request ID) belongs.

not_deletable.description: A flag that indicates whether the work order can be deleted.

disassembly.description: A flag that indicates whether the work order is disassembling something.

may_override_route.description:
A flag that indicates whether the work order can include operations other than those immediately upstream 
or downstream from the current one.

override_serialization.description:
A flag that indicates whether an item that the work order is producing 
and that is normally treated as serialized is not treated as serialized.

input_wo_id.description: The work order ID of the job from which a rework work order originates.

input_oper_id.description: The operation ID of the job from which a rework work order originates.

input_seq_no.description: The sequence number of the job from which a rework work order originates.

spare1.description: The contents of the user-defined spare1 field.

spare2.description: The contents of the user-defined spare2 field.

spare3.description: The contents of the user-defined spare3 field.

spare4.description: The contents of the user-defined spare4 field.

mod_id.description:
The current modification ID of the record in the WO table. This ID is binary number that increments each time the record’s table row is modified. Optionally
            used for optimistic concurrency control when performing updates or deletes.

item_id.description: The ID of the of the item being produced for the work order, unless all its jobs are disassembly jobs, in which case this is the initial item.

release_time_utc.description: When the work order was or will be released, in UTC.

req_finish_time_utc.description: When the work order must be completed, in UTC.

target_sched_line_id.description: The ID of the production line to which the work order is assigned.

reassign.description: A flag indicating whether the work order is a new work order being created or an existing work order being assigned to a new line.

wo_priority.description: The work order priority. This is used as the default priority for jobs in the work order.

cust_info.description: The customer information for the work order.

mo_id.description: The manufacturing order ID, for grouping different final parts.

production_schedule_id.description: The production schedule to which the work order (Production Request ID) belongs.

process_id.description: The ID of the process from which the work order was created.

item_id.description: The ID of the of the item being produced for the work order, unless all its jobs are disassembly jobs, in which case this is the initial item.

req_qty.description: The required quantity of items to be produced for the work order.

user_id.description: The ID of the user who created the work order.

The quantity of items that the work order is expected to produce if there is no rejected production (that is, if all production is good).

spec_ver_id.description: The specification version selected for all operations (if any) when the work order was created.

bom_ver_id.description: The BOM version of the original item that this work order produces specified when it was created.

release_time_utc.description: When the work order was or will be released, in UTC.

req_finish_time_utc.description: When the work order must be completed, in UTC.

wo_priority.description: The work order priority. This is used as the default priority for jobs in the work order.

cust_info.description: The customer information for the work order.

production_schedule_id.description: The production schedule to which the work order (Production Request ID) belongs.

mo_id.description: The manufacturing order, for grouping different final parts.

target_sched_line_id.description: The ID of the production line to which the work order is assigned. This will be null if the work order is not assigned to a line.

queue_seq_no.description: The sequence number of the work order in the queue.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.Quality.Cause.description: The Cause model represents a cause object.

display_seq.description: The cause's display sequence number. This is used to determine the order of causes when they are listed in the user interface.

cause_id.description: The cause ID, assigned by the system.

last_edit_at.description: The date and time when the record was added or last updated.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.Quality.CauseGrp.description: The CauseGrp model represents a cause group object.

cause_grp_id.description: The cause group ID, assigned by the system.

last_edit_at.description: The date and time when the record was added or last updated.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.Quality.Characteris.description: The Characteristic model represents the characteristic object.

type.description:
<para>The type of the characteristic.</para>
<para>0 = variable, (the default)</para>
<para>1 = binary attribute</para>
<para>2 = counted attribute</para>

uom_id.description: The unit of measure ID for the characteristic

severity_cd.description:
<para>The severity of the characteristic.</para>
<para>0 = Unused (not available for data entry)</para>
<para>1 = Not Monitored (run rule violations not checked)</para>
<para>2 = Non-Key (the default)</para>
<para>3 = Key</para>
<para>4 = Critical</para>

default_chart.description:
<para>The default chart of the characteristic.</para>
<para>2 = Xbar + Range</para>
<para>3 = Xbar + Sigma</para>
<para>5 = IX + MR (the default)</para>
<para>7 = MA + Range</para>
<para>8 = MA + Sigma</para>
<para>16 = p</para>
<para>17 = np</para>
<para>18 = u</para>
<para>19 = c</para>
<para>20 = DPMO (coding per QI Analyst)</para>

automated_coll.description: The indication if a characteristic can be collected automatically. The default is no.

time_interval.description: If sample size > 1 and automated_coll is true, the interval between measurements. This is the default for the characteristic, which can be overridden independently at each SRO.

time_int_unit.description:
<para>An enumeration that indicates the unit for the time interval.</para>
<para>0 = seconds</para>
<para>1 = minutes</para>
<para>2 = hours</para>

num_decimals.description: The number of decimals that are displayed. The default is 0.

sample_size_source.description: The source of the sample size. If type = 1 or 2 (attribute): 0 = fixed (the default; the user cannot change the value) 1 = the user has to enter a sample size for the result record 2 = the sample size is copied from the previously entered sample size but is still editable by the user

normal_sample_size.description: If variable or attribute has a fixed sample size, the normal number of measurement in a sample. If variable and normal_sample_size = 1, then the data is not grouped. The default is 1.

minimum_sample_size.description: The minimum number of measurement in a sample. The default is 1.

maximum_sample_size.description: The maximum number of measurement in a sample.

num_defect_opp.description: The number of defect opportunities per piece for a counted attribute.

mov_avg_span.description: The number of subgroups to average for moving average charts.

sigma_est.description:
<para>The sigma estimate. If variable:</para>
<para>0 = Use tables</para>
<para>1 = Use standard deviation</para>

trend_limits.description:
<para>The indication whether there are trend limits. If variable, trend x-bar and IX limits. The default is true.</para>
<para>This property is not used by MES.</para>

use_std_err.description: Indicates whether the standard error of regression is used. If trend_limits is true, use the standard error of regression as sigma estimate. The default is false.

cl_source.description:
<para>The control limit source.</para>
<para>0 = Automatically calculate from data (the default)</para>
<para>1 = Compute from standard mean and standard deviation values (if variable) or compute from standard p, np average proportion and standard c, u average
            number per unit values (if attribute)</para>
<para>2 = Use preset values</para>

samples_for_cl.description: The number of samples to use for calculation of control limits. The default is 0 (use all samples).

samples_before_cl.description: The number of samples required before control limits are calculated. The default is 1.

std_avg.description: The standard average value. If cl_source = 1 and type is variable, this is the standard mean. If type is binary attribute, this is the standard p, np average proportion value. If type is counted attribute, this is the standard c, u average number per unit value.

std_avg_is_target.description: The indication whether to use the target instead of the std_avg value as the standard. If cl_source = 1, the default is true.

std_deviation.description: If variable and cl_source = 1, the standard deviation value.

cl_xbar.description: If variable and cl_source = 2, the center line for xbar.

lcl_xbar.description: If variable and cl_source = 2, the lower control limit for xbar.

ucl_xbar.description: If variable and cl_source = 2, the upper control limit for xbar.

cl_range.description: If variable and cl_source = 2, the center line for range.

lcl_range.description: If variable and cl_source = 2, the lower control limit for range.

ucl_range.description: If variable and cl_source = 2, the upper control limit for range.

cl_sigma.description: If variable and cl_source = 2, the center line for sigma.

lcl_sigma.description: If variable and cl_source = 2, the lower control limit for sigma.

ucl_sigma.description: If variable and cl_source = 2, the upper control limit for sigma.

cl_ix.description: If variable and cl_source = 2, the center line for individual x.

lcl_ix.description: If variable and cl_source = 2, the lower control limit for individual x.

ucl_ix.description: If variable and cl_source = 2, the upper control limit for individual x.

cl_imr.description: If variable and cl_source = 2, the center line for individual moving range.

lcl_imr.description: If variable and cl_source = 2, the lower control limit for individual moving range.

ucl_imr.description: If variable and cl_source = 2, the upper control limit for individual moving range.

cl_ma.description: If variable and cl_source = 2, the center line for moving average.

lcl_ma.description: If variable and cl_source = 2, the lower control limit for moving average.

ucl_ma.description: If variable and cl_source = 2, the upper control limit for moving average.

cl_mr.description: If variable and cl_source = 2, the center line for moving range.

lcl_mr.description: If variable and cl_source = 2, the lower control limit for moving range.

ucl_mr.description: If variable and cl_source = 2, the upper control limit for moving range.

cl_ms.description: If variable and cl_source = 2, the center line for moving sigma.

lcl_ms.description: If variable and cl_source = 2, the lower control limit for moving sigma.

ucl_ms.description: If variable and cl_source = 2, the upper control limit for moving sigma.

cl_p.description: If attribute and cl_source = 2, the center line for p.

lcl_p.description: If attribute and cl_source = 2, the lower control limit for p.

ucl_p.description: If attribute and cl_source = 2, the upper control limit for p.

cl_np.description: If attribute and cl_source = 2, the center line for np.

lcl_np.description: If attribute and cl_source = 2, the lower control limit for np.

ucl_np.description: If attribute and cl_source = 2, the upper control limit for np.

cl_c.description: If attribute and cl_source = 2 the center line for c.

lcl_c.description: If attribute and cl_source = 2, the lower control limit for c.

ucl_c.description: If attribute and cl_source = 2, the upper control limit for c.

cl_u.description: If attribute and cl_source = 2, the center line for u.

lcl_u.description: If attribute and cl_source = 2, the lower control limit for u.

ucl_u.description: If attribute and cl_source = 2, the upper control limit for u.

fit_test.description:
<para>The value that indicates the test to use for a goodness of fit.</para>
<para>0 = Shapiro-Wilk</para>
<para>1 = Kolmogorov-Smirnov</para>
<para>2 = Chi-Square</para>
<para>3 = none</para>

hist_capability_sigma.description:
<para>The value that indicates the Hist capability Sigma.</para>
<para>0 = Estimate using R-Bar</para>
<para>1 = Estimate using S-Bar</para>
<para>2 = Use within-group variation</para>

filter_by_ent_id.description: The indication whether the default dataset is limited by the entity (identified by ent_id) of the current or last sample even if qm_spec has null for the ent_id property. The default is false.

filter_by_item_id.description: The indication whether the default dataset is limited by the item (identified by item_id) of the current or last sample even if qm_spec has null for item_id, item_class_id, and parent_item_class_id. The default is false.

filter_by_wo_id.description: The indication whether the default dataset is limited by the work order (identified by wo_id) of the current or last sample. The default is false.

filter_by_oper_id.description: The indication whether the default dataset is limited by the operation (identified by oper_id) of the current or last sample even if qm_spec has null for oper_id. The default is false.

filter_by_process_id.description: The indication whether the default dataset is limited by the process (identified by process_id) of the current or last sample. The default is false.

filter_by_segment_req_id.description: The indication whether the default dataset is limited by the segment requirement (identified by segment_requirement_id) of the current or last sample. The default is false.

filter_by_segment_resp_id.description: The indication whether the default dataset is limited by the segment response (identified by segment_response_id) of the current or last sample. The default is false.

filter_by_spare1.description: The indication whether the default dataset is limited by the values in the spare1 field of the current or last sample. The default is false.

filter_by_spare2.description: The indication whether the default dataset is limited by the values in the spare2 field of the current or last sample. The default is false.

filter_by_spare3.description: The indication whether the default dataset is limited by the values in the spare3 field of the current or last sample. The default is false.

filter_by_spare4.description: The indication whether the default dataset is limited by the values in the spare4 field of the current or last sample. The default is false.

last_edit_at.description: The date and time the record was added or last updated.

char_id.description: The characteristic ID, assigned by the system.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.Quality.ControlRule.description: The ControlRuleViolation model represents a control rule violation and result value error object.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.Quality.GenerateSam.description: The GenerateSample model represents the generate sample object.

ent_name.description: The name of the entity for which the sample is generated.

site_name.description:
The name of the site to which the supplied entity belongs. Must
be null if sites are not being used.

qm_spec_name.description: The name of the QM specification.

sample_name.description: The name of the sample. Based on the pattern defined in the sample_name field of the Sample_Plan table.

plan_name.description: The name of the sample plan.

item_id.description: The ID of the item from which the sample was generated.

wo_id.description: The ID of the work order of the job for which the sample was generated.

oper_id.description: The ID of the operation of the job for which the sample is generated.

seq_no.description: The ID of the sequence number for the job for which the sample is generated.

expiry_interval.description:
The amount of time, in minutes, to wait for a sample to be pulled before changing its status to Missed. The default is 10. Null means no
            expiration.

warning_interval.description:
The amount of time, in minutes, to wait for a sample to be pulled before changing its status to Ready Warning. The default is 5. Null means no
            warning.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.Quality.SampleFreq.description: The SampleFreq model represents a sample frequency object.

freq_type.description: An enumeration that indicates the sample frequency type. 0 = Shift 1 = Calendar time (the default) 2 = Run time 3 = Production 4 = Main item produced changes (job_bom.current_subst for bom_pos = 0) 5 = Item consumed at any BOM position changes 6 = Lot number of the main item produced changes (job_bom.def_lot_no for bom_pos = 0) 7 = Lot number of an item consumed at any BOM position changes 8 = The job changes 9 = Utilization changes from runtime to downtime 10 = Utilization changes from runtime to idle time 11 = Utilization changes from downtime to runtime 12 = Utilization changes from downtime to idle time 13 = Utilization changes from idle time to runtime 14 = Utilization changes from idle time to downtime 15 = Inventory is received 16 = A new specification value is downloaded for the job running on a job position 17 = A step with action_type 6 starts 18 = A step with action_type 6 finishes 19 = Manual 20 = A job ends

interval.description: If freq_type = 0, 1, or 2, the amount of time between samples (integers only). If freq_type = 3, the amount of production between samples.

interval_unit.description: An enumeration that indicates the interval unit that is the meaning of amount of time or production between samples. 0 = seconds 1= minutes 2 = hours 3 = days 4 = weeks 5 = units of product 6 = number of lots 7 = number of jobs 8 = number of segment responses 0 through 4 are used when freq_type = 0, 1, or 2. 5 through 8 are used when freq_type = 3.

prod_reset_option.description: An enumeration that indicates when the count of production between samples will be reset. Used only if freq_type = 3. 0 = Nothing (no reset ever) 1 = Job changes on job_exec (disallowed if interval_unit = 2) 2 = Main item produced changes 3 = Shift changes on entity 4 = Entity utilization changes from runtime or downtime to idle time

offset_start.description: The offset from the start of the shift, day, or week. Used only if: freq_type = 0. The offset is from the start of the shift. freq_type = 1, if interval_unit = 2, 3, or 4, and if 4, that interval is 1. The offset is the time between midnight (if interval_unit = 2) or midnight Sunday (if interval_unit = 3 or 4). If freq_type = 1 and offset_start = null, then samples are not timed relative to midnight or midnight Sunday.

offset_start_unit.description: The unit of the offset start. 1 = minutes, 2 = hours.

offset_end.description: The offset from the end of the shift. Used only if: freq_type = 0. The offset is from the end of the shift. freq_type = 1, 2, or 3. The offset is the amount of time into the future to predict samples. If offset_end = null, then samples will be created up to the end of the current shift [even if 0 (no shift) when freq_type = 1].

offset_end_unit.description: The unit of the offset end. 1 = minutes, 2 = hours.

samples_per_shift.description: The number of times to ready an event between the offsets from the ends of a shift. Used only if freq_type = 0.

multiplier.description: The sample size multiplier. The minimum value is 1 (the default).

enabled.description: The indication whether the sample plan frequency can be used at runtime.

expiry_time.description: The amount of time to wait for the sample to be pulled before changing its status to Missing. The default is null (no expiration).

expiry_unit.description: The units of expiry_time. 1 = minutes, 2 = hours, 3 = days.

warning_time.description: The amount of time to wait for a sample to be pulled before changing its status to Ready Warning. The default is 5. Null means no warning.

warning_unit.description: The units of warning_time. 1 = minutes (default), 2 = hours, 3 = days.

Mes.WebApi.Models.V3.Util.UtilReason.description: The UtilReason model represents a utilization reason object.

state_cd.description: The utilization state code for this reason.

reas_grp_id.description: The ID of the utilization reason group to which the utilization reason belongs.

runtime.description: The indication whether this utilization reason is used for runtime events.

downtime.description: The indication whether this utilization reason is used for downtime events.

setuptime.description: The indication whether this utilization reason is used for setup time events.

teardowntime.description: The indication whether this utilization reason is used for teardown time events.

fixedtime.description: The indication whether this utilization reason is used for fixed time events.

vartime.description: The indication whether this utilization reason is used for variable time events.

failure.description: The indication whether any time that the entity spends in this utilization reason code is considered failure time.

def_lab_cd.description: The default labor code for the utilization reason when it is manually selected.

display_seq.description:
The display sequence of this reason. The number determines the order of utilization reasons when they are listed under their utilization reason group in the
            user interface.

ent_enabled.description: The indication whether an entity in this utilization reason is to be considered enabled.

priority.description:
The priority of the utilization reason. The priority number is used to determine the reason for a line that has two or more bottleneck entities with differing
            reasons.

max_duration.description: The maximum duration, in seconds, that the utilization reason is considered to be in severe condition before the reason is changed to a new utilization reason code. If new_reas_cd is not being used (that is, it is null) and maximum duration is exceeded, the reason is marked as being Severe and the event is considered to be in a severe condition. The Severe property is typically used with downtime events. If new_reas_cd is being used and the maximum duration is exceeded, the utilization reason for the entity is changed to the new reason specified in new_reas_cd.

new_reas_cd.description: The utilization reason code to which the reason should change when the maximum duration is exceeded.

standard_time.description: The standard amount of time, in minutes, that an entity is expected to be in this utilization reason.

max_time.description: The maximum amount of time, in minutes, that an entity is expected to be in this utilization reason.

min_time.description: The minimum amount of time, in minutes, that an entity is expected to be in this utilization reason.

last_edit_at.description: The date and time when the utilization reason record was added or last updated.

The default priority of a utilization reason that is assigned this utilization state, which is used to determine the reason for a line that has two or more
            bottleneck entities with differing reasons.

max_duration.description: The default maximum duration, in seconds, that a utilization reason that is assigned this utilization state is not considered to be in a severe condition or before the reason is changed to a new utilization reason code. If new_reas_cd is not being used (that is, it is null) and the maximum duration is exceeded, the reason is marked as being Severe and the event is considered to be in a severe condition. The property is typically used with downtime events. If new_reas_cd is being used and the maximum duration is exceeded, the utilization reason for the entity is changed to the new reason specified in new_reas_cd.

new_reas_cd.description: The default utilization reason to which a reason that is assigned this utilization state should change when the maximum duration is exceeded.

standard_time.description: The default standard amount of time, in minutes, that an entity is expected to be in a utilization reason that is assigned this utilization state.

min_time.description: The default minimum amount of time, in minutes, that an entity is expected to be in a utilization reason that is assigned this utilization state.
